notes: Proposed finite Phase A authority; effective for implementation only after this governance PR is genuinely independently reviewed and merged into trusted main. Its presence on the proposal branch is not authority. First document-intake persistence boundary only, not completed FNS verification. This phase is deliberately STAFF APPLICATION intake for a pending NEW_ORGANIZATION registration application; it is not organization-admin intake, because the existing auth.resolve_organization_admin_session function correctly requires a VERIFIED organization and therefore cannot authorize pre-admission legal-entity evidence. Current Deal-bound StorageService must not be reused by fabricating a deal. Use a separate application-bound quarantine schema, retain original bounded PDF bytes and server-computed hashes, never accept client signature/trust/verdict or tenant/organization/INN/OGRN authority. The caller supplies only server-authenticated platform actor id/session id, exact registration application id, original PDF bytes and idempotency key. Inside one bounded database capability, platform-review authority is re-derived through the existing SECURITY DEFINER auth.registration_platform_actor_authorized(text,text); the exact application is bound and locked through the existing SECURITY DEFINER auth.lock_registration_decision_application(text,text,text,text,text,text,text) with actor kind PLATFORM_REVIEWER; and the tenant/organization/INN/OGRN are cross-checked against the existing SECURITY DEFINER auth.read_role_eligibility_candidates(text). The exact lock result must be kind NEW_ORGANIZATION, the candidate and lock tuples must agree on application id/version/status/organization/tenant, and only reviewable pending/suspended states may enter or replay. The same authorization/application/candidate checks repeat after any advisory-lock wait and before replay or write. No existing auth/registration/role-eligibility function body or grant is modified. The new NOLOGIN/NOINHERIT capability owner may receive only schema USAGE and EXECUTE on those three existing bounded functions; no auth/registration/identity table privilege, existing role membership or registration transition is authorized. The finite intake/read functions may be executable only by the dedicated staff database principals pc_staff_runtime/app_staff/one_deal_staff when present; general deal/auth/storage/outbox runtimes must have no EXECUTE. Original object, application-scoped idempotency receipt, capacity counters and append-only audit commit atomically. Same actor/application/key with different bytes conflicts; exact replay cannot bypass current staff authority or current application status; content-addressed dedup is scoped to tenant, organization and application. No default capacity policy; missing reviewed budget fails closed. Explicit total and per-application byte/receipt quotas, bounded input, advisory/row locks, lock/statement timeouts and deterministic rollback are required. Every receipt remains QUARANTINED and authoritative=false. This phase exposes no HTTP route, registers no module in AppModule, schedules no worker and changes no registration/legal/admission verdict. No production trust pin, freshness rule, cryptographic dependency or FNS subscriber access is approved by this manifest. API/authentication keys, source PDFs, CRLs, private keys and binary dependencies must not enter git. Existing auth/registration/staff/role-eligibility migration and application files are immutable. The generated cryptographic inventory pair is allowed only as deterministic output of the unchanged existing generator if the new source files require it. Acceptance must execute the actual proposed SQL on disposable PostgreSQL with an actual restricted STAFF connection and source-bound byte-identical copies of the three existing bounded authority helpers against explicit minimal fixtures; it must prove pending NEW_ORGANIZATION acceptance while organization status is still PENDING, platform-role/recent-MFA/session/credential/assignment revocation denial, non-staff/general-runtime denial, application-id subject derivation, JOIN_EXISTING_ORGANIZATION denial, changed/rejected application replay denial, candidate/lock mismatch fail-closed, cross-application/tenant/org isolation, replay/conflict/concurrency, direct SQL denials, immutable originals/audit, quotas and full transaction rollback. The smoke must also exercise the migration against the current full repository migration baseline, not only minimal fixtures, before implementation merge. Database restart is not backup/restore; restore/DR remains separately required where applicable. Full repository CI, exact-head independent review and final live base/head compatibility remain mandatory before merge. The implementation branch cannot edit this scope or grant itself authority. No use of a homepage-only exception or owner self-audit as independent review. This is separate from #5127 and must not overwrite its 14-path scope. Registration code/behavior unchanged; ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_ENFORCEMENT=false; production only REG.RU; no production database mutation or release in this phase; no new mandatory one-time or recurring cost.
